summary: First Mining Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 10, 2026, announcing initial assay results from its 2026 exploration drilling program at the Duparquet Gold Project in Quebec, Canada. Highlight intercepts include 5.26 g/t Au over 19.55 m in hole DUP26-093 and 3.43 g/t Au over 28.0 m in DUP26-096, extending the Miroir discovery's strike length to roughly 220 m. No corporate transaction, board recommendation, or advisory mandate is disclosed; this is a routine operational update, not a special situation. Watch future resource-update and development-study milestones rather than deal terms.
